claim_boundary: A pass supports a low-dimensional, gauge-regularized mechanism-coordinate realization: a shared coordinate prior can be rebound from ten input-selected calibration measurements in a new physical system and improve held-out executable transfer without arbitrary source warping. It does not establish unique dimensional coordinates, exact Reynolds-number physics, arbitrary nonlinear reparameterization, broad-domain generality, or general AI scientific discovery.

development.lambda_selection: nested family-disjoint 5-fold development; all five outer folds independently selected lambda=0.03

holdout.exclusion_reason: one apce_12x6 dynamic file was inspected only to validate URL format before the holdout protocol was frozen; the entire family is excluded
holdout.metadata_reconstruction: parse .txt hrefs from the frozen index; accept apce_DxP_provenance_RPM.txt; exclude apce_12x6; sort each family by (RPM,url); exact href deduplication only

coordinate.note: J is used only to algebraically reconstruct dimensional airspeed because UIUC files report J rather than tunnel airspeed. J itself is not supplied to the coordinate binder or predictors.

calibration.run_selection: sort runs by metadata RPM; calibration indices are round((n-1)/3) and round(2*(n-1)/3), with ties/duplicates resolved upward to distinct indices if ever needed
calibration.probe_selection: for each calibration run, compute linear empirical airspeed quantile targets and choose nearest distinct observed row sequentially; ties choose lower row index
calibration.binder_score: symmetric cross-calibration-run prediction error; fit CT(z) and CP(z) separately with degree-2 Chebyshev on five probes from one run, predict in-support probes of the other, reverse direction, geometric-mean normalized CT/CP error, then add lambda*(b-b0)^2
calibration.candidate_invalid_if: either direction has fewer than 3 target probes inside source calibration support

prediction.fit: combine all ten calibration probes and fit CT(z) and CP(z) separately with degree-3 Chebyshev least squares
prediction.common_scoring_support: a confirmatory row is scored only if its coordinate lies within the calibration support for adaptive, fixed-global, and canonical models; therefore every compared model is scored on exactly the same physical rows
prediction.family_joint_error: sqrt(CT_NRMSE * CP_NRMSE) on all scored confirmatory rows concatenated within family

controls.fixed_global: same ten probes and degree-3 CT/CP models with b=-1.12
controls.canonical: same ten probes and degree-3 CT/CP models with b=-1.0
controls.unregularized_adaptive: diagnostic only; same candidate grid and binder without shrinkage
